Initial release of the services-video skill — a fast, cloud-based AI service for editing and exporting professional service videos.

- Instantly edit and export your service videos by simply describing your needs (trim, add intro, etc.).
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM), with fast cloud GPU-powered rendering and export.
- No video editing experience needed — ideal for marketers seeking polished results in minutes.
- Automated onboarding: handles token generation and backend setup for you.
- Robust error handling and clear workflow instructions for common actions like upload, edit, and export.
